label: Example knowledge base · fictional Apex Build Co.

chunks.title: Past proposal — Riverside Leisure Centre HVAC upgrade (2024)
chunks.text: Apex Build Co. delivered a phased HVAC upgrade at Riverside Leisure Centre while keeping the pool hall in partial use. Two AHUs with rotary heat recovery (72% certified) were crane-lifted over two weekend shutdowns. Temporary ducting maintained supply to changing rooms. QC included duct leakage tests to DW/143 and BMS trend logging for 14 days post-commissioning. Client: Riverside Parks Trust (fictional). Value: $920k. Duration: 11 weeks.

chunks.title: Past proposal — Oakwood School sports hall envelope (2023)
chunks.text: South façade glazing replacement at Oakwood School sports hall used unitised double-glazed panels Uw 1.2 W/m²K fixed to retained mullions. Weather contingency of 10 working days was built into the programme. Temporary weatherproofing with shrink-wrap and scaffold fans protected the timber floor. Night works limited to 22:00 by neighbour agreement. Value: $640k. Duration: 9 weeks. Zero reportable incidents.

chunks.title: Method note — temporary works for roof plant lifts
chunks.text: Standard Apex temporary works pack for roof plant: appointed temporary works designer (Chartered Engineer), outrigger load checks on existing structure, exclusion zones managed by banksman radios, and a trial lift at 110% of plant weight. Lift plans submitted 10 working days before mobilisation. This pack was reused on Riverside and Harborview jobs with site-specific appendices.

chunks.title: Reference — Harborview Community Arena finishes (2022)
chunks.text: Client contact: J. Keller, Facilities Lead, Harborview Arena Board (fictional). Scope: sports floor Class P1, wall padding, and LED lighting upgrade. Contract value $410k. Completed on programme. Defects liability closed with no outstanding items. Suitable evidence for sports surface Class P1 requirement.

chunks.title: Reference — Greenfield Aquatic Centre plant room (2021)
chunks.text: Client contact: M. Okonkwo, Capital Projects, Greenfield Leisure (fictional). Scope: plant room AHU replacement and heat recovery retrofit in an occupied public leisure building. Value $1.1M. Duration 14 weeks with weekend changeovers. ISO 9001 certificate provided with handover pack.

chunks.title: CV — Samira Haddad, Project Manager
chunks.text: Samira Haddad — Project Manager, Apex Build Co. 11 years experience on public building works. Recent: Riverside Leisure HVAC ($920k), Oakwood envelope ($640k), Harborview finishes ($410k). Holds CSCS black card equivalent and SMSTS. Available full-time from November 2026. Fluent English; based within 40 minutes of Northbridge.

chunks.title: CV — Tomasz Lewandowski, Site Supervisor
chunks.text: Tomasz Lewandowski — Site Supervisor. 9 years site supervision on education and leisure projects. Strong façade and temporary weatherproofing experience (Oakwood 2023). First-aid and working-at-height tickets current. Proposed resident supervisor for the 14-week hall closure window.

chunks.title: CV — Priya Nair, HVAC Lead
chunks.text: Priya Nair — HVAC Lead / Commissioning Engineer. 8 years mechanical packages. Certifications: heat-recovery commissioning, BMS integration, duct leakage testing. Led Riverside AHU changeover. Proposed to supervise plant selection to meet ≥70% heat recovery and post-install trend logging.

chunks.title: Certificate — ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management
chunks.text: Apex Build Co. holds ISO 9001:2015 certificate #QMS-88421 (fictional registrar NorthPeak Cert). Scope: design-assist and construction of building services and renovation works. Valid through 2027-06-30. Surveillance audit passed 2026-03.

chunks.title: Insurance certificate summary
chunks.text: Public liability: $10M any one occurrence (exceeds $5M requirement). Professional indemnity for temporary works design: $3M aggregate (exceeds $2M). Employers liability as required by local law. Broker: Atlas Cover Partners (fictional). Renewal date 2027-01-15.

chunks.title: Plant & equipment list — façade and HVAC packages
chunks.text: Owned/leased plant available for Northbridge hall: 45t mobile crane (weekend hire agreement), 800 m² system scaffold with fans, shrink-wrap weather kit, two 12k m³/h temporary AHUs for occupied-zone tempering, duct fabrication bench, MEWPs (x3), floor protection rolls for Class P1 install. Logistics yard 12 km from site.

chunks.title: Environmental note — construction waste diversion
chunks.text: Apex waste policy targets ≥75% diversion from landfill on public renovation jobs. Segregated skips for metal, clean timber, plasterboard, and mixed. Monthly waste register issued to client. On Oakwood envelope, measured diversion reached 78%. Suitable response to the ≥70% diversion requirement.

chunks.title: Template programme — 14-week sports hall closure
chunks.text: Template sequence: W1–2 enablement & soft strip; W3–6 façade + temporary weatherproofing; W3–8 HVAC plant & risers (parallel); W8 changing rooms handover; W9–12 sports floor & finishes; W13 commissioning; W14 snagging & demobilise. Weather float: 8 working days on façade. Matches buyer maximum continuous closure of 14 weeks.

chunks.title: QC plan excerpt — sports floor Class P1
chunks.text: Incoming board moisture checks, adhesive batch records, rebound and shock absorption spot tests against Class P1, and photographic hold-points before line marking. Color match against buyer sample board photographed under 4000K lighting. Used successfully at Harborview Arena.
